name: ES Opening Liquidity Wormhole v1
instrument: ES continuous front-month signal with one MES execution unit
hypothesis: The opening minute that produces the greatest directional displacement per traded contract reveals the auction's local path of least resistance. Its direction maps a liquidity void rather than a volume-supported move, and that low-resistance direction should persist through the cash session.

signal.minute_efficiency: absolute minute displacement divided by reported minute volume
signal.selection: minute with the greatest efficiency; choose the earliest minute on an exact tie
signal.zero_rule: no trade if the selected minute displacement equals zero
signal.interpretation: trade in the direction that required the least volume per unit of realized directional movement

execution.entry: 10:00 open plus one adverse ES tick
execution.stop_fill: one adverse ES tick beyond the applicable opening extreme
execution.entry_validity: skip if the frozen stop fill is not adverse to the simulated entry
execution.same_bar_rule: if the 10:00 entry bar touches the stop trigger, assume the stop fills
execution.gap_through_rule: if a stop bar opens beyond the trigger, fill at the worse bar open plus one adverse tick; otherwise fill at the frozen stop price
execution.survivor_exit: 15:30 open plus one adverse ES tick
execution.position_limit: one MES and at most one trade per RTH session

lesson: The most displacement-efficient opening minute did not reveal a persistent liquidity void. Low-volume movement was more consistent with temporary impact or noise, and both directions lost. Reversing the selected direction or changing the displacement definition is prohibited.
holdout_policy: 2024-2025 was not evaluated because the unchanged rule failed its development gates.
prohibited_posthoc_changes: trading against rather than with the selected minute
using high-low range, close-to-close change, or typical-price change instead of the frozen body displacement
using multiple selected minutes or an efficiency threshold
weekday, volatility, volume, or regime filters
changing the stop or exit after observing results
